games.name: 8AM: The Warehouse
games.summary: "8AM: The Warehouse" is a suspense game set in a massive distribution center late at night. Monitor security cameras as strange incidents occur among the remaining workers — and decide if it’s exhaustion, system error, or something lurking between the shelves until 8:00 a.m.

games.name: Absolution
games.summary: Absolution is a full 3D first-person adventure game where story, graphics, animation, sound and original music intertwine to put a spell on you as you immerse yourself in the non-linear gameplay, with captivating environments and interesting characters. The characters in the game do indeed want absolution, from an unfavourable past where tinkering with the unknown has given birth to the "Entropy", an uncontrollable vortex. As the main character asks for your help, you are confronted with a giant theme park guitar that has been ripped apart, while the Entropy pulsates dangerously in the background. Your only transport between the islands is an old hoverflyer that barely holds together, but it swiftly takes you on the adventure in discovering seven islands and the mysteries they pose. Along the journey, you will meet live action characters that are haunted by their own past, and as you slowly learn their oddities, they may indeed choose to help you.

games.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
games.summary: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

games.name: Aetheris Core
games.summary: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

games.name: Afterbeat
games.summary: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

games.name: Aion 2
games.summary:
Aion 2 takes place 200 years after the PC game, Aion: The Tower of Eternity.

One main feature is the appearance of dimensional cracks, allowing players from different servers to engage in large-scale PVP. Gliding and wings will no doubt be there as the IP’s signature element. NCsoft even claimed Aion 2 will have features which could not be realized in the PC game, and that its vision for the game is “no longer a dream”. Such big lofty words.

Perhaps the biggest difference is that there are no longer the 2 opposing factions, Elyos and Asmodians (due to the timeline). Players are free to choose to invade others of defend. Another eye-opener is the claim of not having “class segmentation” in Aion 2, with players able to wield different weapons without restrictions and choose their playstyle. NCsoft claims that Aion 2 will “showcase a new battle system that did not exist in the old Aion”.

Finally, another huge change is the removal of gliding constraints found in Aion. While this was not explained in detail, NCsoft is aiming to make gliding part of the combat loop to create a “three dimensional battle system”. NCsoft did not mention what engine Aion 2 is developed on, but my guess is Unreal Engine 5. Stay tuned for more updates on the game!

games.name: Atomic Age
games.summary: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years

games.name: Bojan
games.summary: You think you have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

games.name: Close the Sky
games.summary: A real-time war of air defence and industry. Build the economy, bury it, and layer SAMs over what you cannot hide. Read a fading intel picture of the enemy base and aim every missile yourself. Break their will to fight before they break yours.

games.name: Company of Heroes: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition, features the original Company of Heroes along with the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor Expansions, enhanced visuals, quality-of-life gameplay improvements, and 64-bit platform support.

games.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
games.summary: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.summary: A gothic action-adventure RPG of violent angels and dead gods.

games.name: Crow's Foot
games.summary: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

games.name: Cute Country
games.summary: You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom. There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

games.name: Death Penalty
games.summary: You are sentenced to death... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

games.name: Desk Top Racer
games.summary: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

games.name: Dreamscapes
games.summary: Investigate six haunted properties and listen to the voices of spirits trapped in nightmares. Collect fragmented clues and discover the correct combination of names, locations, and vessels. A multi-ending horror adventure where the outcome changes depending on your choices during the ritual.

games.name: Dvor
games.summary: A falling-block puzzle game rooted in Soviet aesthetics. Lock concretes into a living facade as the seasons turn and the music shifts with them. Dvor means courtyard – the place where Soviet children played, where life happened. The version the falling blocks game always deserved.

games.name: Endless Isolation
games.summary: Endless Isolation is a classic first-person Survival Horror in PSX style, where the line between office routine and nightmare is erased forever.

games.name: Eona
games.summary: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

games.name: Fablewood Chronicles
games.summary:
Fablewood Chronicles is an idle strategy game about a civilization of moveable regions that keeps running whether or not you are watching it.

You buy a region and put it somewhere. Every region type reaches a certain distance, so two placed within reach of each other open a road between them. Money cannot improve that road. It improves because people walk it, and a worn road is faster and kinder to the traveller on it. Wear enough of them in and the lines stop being lines: roads bundle into trunks, crossings collapse into junctions, and highways curve between the places your people actually go. Drag the two regions apart and the road between them is lost permanently.

games.name: First Light
games.summary: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

games.name: Grail
games.summary: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

games.name: Gravitaws
games.summary: Gravitaws is a retro-style stage shooter inspired by Jaws (NES). Explore a dynamic overworld map. Collect research materials and upgrades, while evading an Alien invader. The story is delivered in classic style cutscenes. Fight bosses, survive, collect, fish, and bomb your way to victory.

games.name: HMUR
games.summary: HMUR is a fast-paced retro-FPS, in the original setting, that merges Soviet aesthetics with whacky madness and frantic dynamics of iconic 90s shooters. Survive a disaster at a classified Soviet facility as you blast your way through crowds of enemies. Speed is your key to survival.

games.name: Haunted Bar Simulator
games.summary: Run a cozy bar with friends by day. Serve strange customers and survive the horror by night.

games.name: Immortal Chess
games.summary: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

games.name: Internet Cafe 98
games.summary: Grow a small 1998 internet cafe from a single outdated PC into a packed business. Serve customers, upgrade your computers and network, and research new technology in this retro incremental tycoon game.

games.name: Kernel Hearts
games.summary: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

games.name: Launch Them All
games.summary: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties. Casual strategy in an approachable, classic style!

games.name: Leafblade
games.summary: The coziest mix of ARPG and monster tamer. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

games.name: Locked in Love: The Office
games.summary: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

games.name: Love All My Girls
games.summary: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

games.name: Magical Blush
games.summary: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

games.name: OneMore
games.summary: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

games.name: Operation: Outbreak Idle
games.summary: Command automated military defenses, upgrade your fortress, and survive massive zombie waves in this action-packed idle defense game. Build powerful defenses, unlock upgrades, and hold the line against endless undead hordes.

games.name: Otterly Lost
games.summary: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. In this story-rich adventure, explore wild forests, dive underwater, glide over rocky canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete heartfelt quests, and enjoy soft challenges, at your own pace!

games.name: Pix Football Manager
games.summary: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

games.name: Plushy Store Tidy Up
games.summary:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

games.name: Pro Wrestling Tycoon
games.summary: Pro Wrestling Tycoon is a day-by-day wrestling promotion management sim. Book shows, manage contracts and storylines, negotiate network deals, and compete in a living industry of rival companies, news, and backstage drama. Deep modding and Steam Workshop support let you shape the universe.

games.name: Rogue Planet
games.summary: Veloria is the only world Reva and her friends have ever known. Is escaping the village's walls a good idea? Play as Reva and explore both the horrors and beauty of the outside world in Rogue. And most importantly, never, ever let the bad guys win.

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.summary: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy rogue-like deck-builder that weaves together the haunting narrative depth and corrupted world-building of games like Elden Ring with the strategic card combat of Slay the Spire. Fight, discover, dies and repeat.

games.name: Rushcremental
games.summary: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

games.name: Skullchef
games.summary: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Steelarchy
games.summary: Steelarchy is a 3rd-person vehicle combat roguelike centered on deep loadouts. Face off against a modular fortress of rigid steel in explosive, chaotic battles. With deep meta-progression and shifting enemy tactics, no two matches are the same. Build. Customize. Upgrade. Embrace the carnage.

games.name: Thanks, Light.
games.summary: [Thanks, Light.] is a first-person 3D geometry puzzle game where you shine and absorb light to transform 2D and 3D states.Watch as one boy saves a world that has lost its light.

games.name: The Death Game Report
games.summary: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

games.name: The Guild: Europa 1410
games.summary: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

The Solyani's Code
games.summary: A Sci-Fi story set on the moon Selene, featuring LUMA, a glowing companion that assists you with unique abilities.

games.name: Tiny Survivors
games.summary: Fight through endless hordes of enemies in this action-packed roguelite. Collect powerful loot, level up, unlock new characters, and combine upgrades to create wild builds as you grow stronger with every run. How long can you survive the onslaught?

games.name: Total Victory
games.summary: A grand strategy World War II wargame engine. The main scenario is World Conflict 1939-1945. Players get to play any combination of the big 8 major powers during World War 2.

games.name: Train Station Tycoon
games.summary: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

games.name: Untouchable Ground
games.summary: You are a wandering fox, caught between warring animal clans, forgotten forest gods, and a secret that can unravel the world. The forest watches. Every step, every choice, could be your last.

games.name: Velhodium Isle
games.summary: Velhodium Isle is a pixel-art boomer shooter in which you fight monsters in themed locations. Use weapons and magic to get through crowds of monsters and close the source of apocalyptic terrors. Disable shields, close the anomaly, and survive the brutal slaughter!

games.name: Venera 31
games.summary: The orbital eyes are gone. You are the last operator watching Venus. Scan a hostile surface through a dying camera and verify what's growing down there — before the signal, and the truth, go dark for good.

games.name: We Are Gum
games.summary: A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

games.name: Writer Tycoon
games.summary: Become a bestselling author in Writer Tycoon! Write books, grow your fanbase, and dominate the publishing industry. Track sales, manage multiple books at once, and adapt to trends. Will you create literary masterpieces or chase quick cash? Become a bestselling author and leave your mark!

games.name: Zombie Must Dead!
games.summary: "Zombie Must Dead!" is a game that combines tower defense and FPS elements. Players must continuously fend off waves of zombies, upgrade their weapons, and strive to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

games.name: Bombanana!
games.summary: You are a 3-player bomb defusal team made up of three monkeys: blind, deaf, and mute. Inside your minivan turned mobile bomb workshop, you must defuse bombs before they explode using limited time and limited communication!

games.name: Fofumia
games.summary: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

games.name: Monster Ops 22
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Stuck in the Sewers
games.summary: Stuck in the Sewers is a chill puzzle game about finding your way out in a maze of pipes.

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.summary: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: AereA
games.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage, Claude the Trumpet-Gunner, or team up with your friends in local co-op. Collect Music Sheets to learn new skills and customize your weapons to your play style.

games.name: Beetleball
games.summary: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game to ever exist.

games.name: BioEden
games.summary: Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

games.name: Cozy Banker
games.summary: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

games.name: Florence Mirror
games.summary: Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in modern Florence, where a hidden mirror dimension unleashes monstrous reflections of human sins. As Leonardo Tornabuoni, fight through 30+ bosses, master arcane powers, and choose between a story-driven path or a brutal Souls-like challenge.

games.name: Friendly Steps
games.summary: A physics-based 1-4 player co-op disaster about getting home after a wild night out. It was a fun night! Now grab your buddies and walk home. If you remember how.

games.name: Liminal Shroud
games.summary: A psychological exploration experience that takes you deep into the heart of uncanny, in-between spaces where reality unravels. There are no monsters here—only the shadows of your own mind. Navigate strangely layered rooms, interact with the environment and unlock secrets to escape.

games.name: Little Problems
games.summary: Little Problems is a Cozy Detective game about solving mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.

games.name: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia
games.summary: Help the Marsupilamis save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions in this fast-paced 2D platformer! A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake!

games.name: Monk Took Book
games.summary: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

games.name: Orbitals
games.summary:
Team up as Maki and Omura, two inseparable explorers with a whole lot more determination than experience. You’ll brave the perils of space in search of help for their crumbling station home, now trapped within a supernatural cosmic storm.

Orbitals captures the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, either in local split-screen or online, Orbitals rewards smart teamwork and clear communication. Use each character’s unique tools to open the path forward, overcome danger, and meet out-of-this-world creatures and characters on a bombastic adventure.

games.name: ShipShaper
games.summary: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

games.name: Shoe it All!
games.summary: Swing, fling, and cause chaos with your shoes in this physics-based mayhem. Discover secrets, unlock bonus levels, customize your look, and fill your journal with shiny stickers. Master the perfect throw and SHOE IT ALL!

games.name: ShoreTiles
games.summary: Build your island around a fragile lighthouse in this Gloomy tile-placement strategy game. Balance growth, economy, and defense - because when night falls, THEY will rise from the depths.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Outrun, outjump, and outsmart your rivals in cutthroat online/local races, now up to 8 players. Master the movement, learn meticulously designed maps, use powerful pick-ups, swing around with a grappling hook, and don't get knocked off-screen!

games.name: Star Racer
games.summary: Compete to be the first, or only, racer to finish and become the fastest in the galaxy. Welcome to Star Racer! Get ready for a journey through time and space, where speed, skill, and sheer radness will determine the ultimate racer. Star Racer awaits - buckle up for the retro ride of a lifetime!

games.name: Superstar Strategy
games.summary: Muster your army and take on a variety of enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Draft units and use unique skills and terrain to wage war alone, together with your friends, or against them in PvE and PvP modes across a variety of objective types. Raise your battle standard and seize the day!

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

trailers.name: The Dawnwalker Saga - A Glimpse Into The Future

games.name: Vikings Pinball
games.summary: Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible. Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!

games.name: Welcome Demon
games.summary: You are a dungeon warden. Sitting in the chair of the previous warden you killed, you must cleanse yourself of your sins within 666 hours. Place the incoming demons into six different dungeons based on your information, intuition, and limited resources.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.summary:
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo.

Set during a fictionalised version of the fall of the Han Dynasty, the plot follows an unnamed protagonist who battles historical characters and Chinese mythological creatures corrupted by demonic qi.

games.name: Black Cat Book Club
games.summary: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.

games.name: Chaos Front
games.summary: A turn-based space mecha mercenary game. You can recruit pilots and captains with varying stories and skills, buy and modify spaceships, mecha, artillery, and fighters, take missions, participate in battles between Galactic Powers, change the situations, and experience different stories.

games.name: Cupid's Chatroom
games.summary: Find your true love with the help of Cupid's chatroom, a mysterious server that won't let you leave!

games.name: Dream Cage
games.summary: Robert battles early Alzheimer's and nightly sleep paralysis. Each night reveals fragments of his past. Uncover the truth and help him solve the mysteries haunting his mind.

games.name: Dungeon Raid
games.summary: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

games.name: Fear the Timeloop
games.summary: Fear The Timeloop is a survival horror game where every fifteen minutes, the protagonist dies and resets to the starting point. Can you break the cycle and escape the loop?

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve head-scratching puzzles, and fight dangerous enemies in this retro-inspired action adventure.

games.name: My Hero Academia: All's Justice
games.summary: SMASH through My Hero Academia’s final story arc and triumph over your foes in spectacular 3v3 battles! Follow the trials of Deku and other characters in the Final War between Heroes and Villains!

games.name: NHL 27
games.summary:
EA Sports NHL 27 brings the identity of every NHL team to life on the ice, in the arena, and through the broadcast.

Experience Authentic Atmospheres across all 32 NHL arenas, each designed to capture the sound, spectacle, and identity of its home team. Real-world goal songs, new pregame introductions, and a fully overhauled crowd bring every building closer to its real-world counterpart.

games.name: Not Enough Space
games.summary: Shoot to move. Move to survive. A space action roguelike about momentum, chaotic battles, loot, builds, and bosses.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Order Automatica
games.summary: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.

games.name: Penguin Fury
games.summary: Penguin Fury is a 2D roguelite auto-battler where players draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, equip weapons, and survive endless waves of enemies. The game features interactive Twitch and Kick chat integration allowing viewers to join battles, 70 unlockable skins across 6 historical eras, a deck-building Joker relic system, and full localization in 39 languages.

games.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno
games.summary: Remake of Phantom of Inferno with completely redrawn art in the style of the 2009's anime. The voice cast was also replaced by the one used in the anime.

games.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno - Nitro Archive
games.summary:
A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam!
The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.
*Voiceover is only available in Japanese.

games.name: The Swashbugglers
games.summary: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

games.name: The Zyrdain Sands
games.summary: Visceral twin-stick shooter where desert gods sabotage your run with no-shots, sandstorms, and cursed upgrades while you evolve Zyrd's weapons to save the Sacred Stone.

games.name: Witch Cabin Cleanup
games.summary: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: Galactic Prospectors
games.summary: Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by a rogue AI (you can play as the Rogue AI, or as a regular Astronaut out in the universe). Take on the universe against rogue AIs, other humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI if you wish to play as such, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.

games.name: Shalter 03
games.summary: Shalter 03 is an asymmetric first-person co-op puzzle-adventure game where three players take control of characters deprived of sight, hearing, and speech. Stranded in a hazardous facility, players must collaborate tightly to overcome their unique physical limitations, communicate through environmental cues, and balance real-time buffs and debuffs to solve complex puzzles before the clock runs out.

games.name: Crazy Pocket
games.summary: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

games.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
games.summary: Jump into a Hot Wheels-sized world with four islands packed with events, challenges and full-throttle mayhem. Collect iconic vehicles, assemble your Rush Squad, build epic tracks, and earn the title of Rush Master.

games.name: Nothing Strange Here
games.summary:
Nothing Strange Here is a single-player open-world adventure game with mystery and slice-of-life elements. Set in the small town of Larcenest Gap, players take on the role of a reporter exploring the community, documenting strange events, and interacting with townsfolk.

The game combines narrative discovery with photography and journaling mechanics. Players can photograph scenes, collect evidence, and publish their findings in a customizable in-game journal. NPCs follow daily routines, and the world changes based on the player's actions and the time of day. Additional features include hidden collectibles, such as stickers and gnomes, and dynamic events that encourage exploration and investigation.

games.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
games.summary: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

games.name: The Well Is Not Empty
games.summary: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

games.name: WheelMates
games.summary: WheelMates is a 2-player co-op adventure where you and a friend drive tiny RC cars through the home laboratory of an eccentric scientist. Coming to Steam on September 7 with Friend’s Pass.

games.name: Bones and Coins
games.summary: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

games.name: Bus Simulator 27
games.summary: Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet, with new officially licensed brands and bus models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

games.name: Dealer's Dice
games.summary: Dealer's Dice is a high-stakes dice defense game engineered for true gamblers. Collect powerful dice, manage your betting table, and test your luck against an endless onslaught. Will you play it safe, or push your luck for the ultimate jackpot? Remember, you only have one life.

games.name: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
games.summary: Build a global industrial empire on a 3D planet earth. Mine resources, manufacture complex goods, trade across continents, and shape your companys reputation through powerful policies. Control every step of the supply chain and turn industry into influence.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.summary: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Orc Incremental
games.summary: Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in this incremental auto battler. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth.

games.name: Sprawl Zero
games.summary: Sprawl Zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

games.name: The Glued
games.summary: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

games.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
games.summary: Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

games.name: Trudge
games.summary: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

games.name: Undying Flame
games.summary: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

games.name: Voldark
games.summary: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

games.name: Yandere Virus
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

games.name: Between Adventures Idle
games.summary: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

games.name: Cosmic Fear
games.summary: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

games.name: Detective VR
games.summary: Step into a thrilling narrative investigation in Virtual Reality! In DETECTIVE VR, you control time, collect crucial clues, and interview witnesses to unravel the plot.

games.name: In Falsus
games.summary:
"In Falsus" ties music gameplay to a tale of lies and truth, told through the eyes of 5 girls in a modern world both familiar and not.

An atmospheric soundscape awaits across 70+ songs—including more than 40 originals—arriving on release and produced by composers at the forefront of Japan's independent music scene.

games.name: Iron Wasteland
games.summary: After the bombs fell, civilization collapsed into chaos. Scavenge the ruins of a shattered world, gather vital resources, and fight off hostile enemies determined to claim what little remains.

games.name: Thalia
games.summary: Thalia is a fast paced roguelike action game. You as Thalia has been summoned to this ancient place where death is not the end, it is only the beginning. Fight hoards of enemies, giant bosses and improve in an infinite mechanic where death only makes you stronger!

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies. The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

games.name: Valheim
games.summary: Valheim is a brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally-generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Craft powerful weapons, construct longhouses, and slay mighty foes to prove yourself to Odin!

games.name: Waifu Wars Online
games.summary: Kill, loot, and level up with other players in this mysterious online realm. Welcome to WAIFU WARS ONLINE!

games.name: Welcome to Mars 9
games.summary: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

games.name: A Night in Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
games.summary: Are you ready for the session? Let yourself be hypnotized and dive into the dazzling world of Moka Efti, known from the series *Babylon Berlin*. As a journalist, you’ll follow the clues to a mysterious case at the famous nightclub. But can you trust your memories?

games.name: Arc Salvo
games.summary: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

games.name: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
games.summary: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean up job of the year. Tens of thousands of items: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect and dirt to tidy up. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Crosstalk
games.summary: Crosstalk is a game that takes place in a printed circuit board city that players build, which follows realistic electrical rules that will have to be dealt with in order to maintain city operations. It includes a sandbox mode (with optional co-op) and an adversarial mode, where players compete.

games.name: Dungeon Settlers
games.summary: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your clan to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

games.name: Fountains
games.summary: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of an ancient, interconnected world.

games.name: Fuyukuru.: Winter winds, adieu?
games.summary: A “denpa” visual novel about a grisly murder in a sealed institution for immortal girls. Wool needle, knitting needle, sewing machine needle. Silk needle, stitching needle, injection needle. Futon needle, clothing needle, hook for a fish. Follow the needles to your immortal death.

games.name: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
games.summary: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi is an Adventure game, developed by Pandora Box and published by Banpresto, which was released in Japan in 1995.

games.name: Garden Ink
games.summary: Paint, merge, and explore! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox/exploration game where you shape and grow your own world. Merging decorations and coloring tools help you customize your world. With hand-painted visuals and a soothing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.

games.name: Hazard Pay
games.summary: In this dark and mysterious block-pushing puzzler, you'll navigate through a secret, hazardous laboratory complex. Discover creative methods to destroy evidence and cover up the crimes of your employer.

games.name: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
games.summary: The classic visual novel "HimaNatsu" from the critically acclaimed developer Makura is finally available in English for the first time! Weave a cheerful yet sometimes painful tale of promises and redemption together with the Oboshiro Choir Squad in this never-ending summer vacation.

games.name: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
games.summary: Pick your champions and fight in merciless 1v1 turn-based matches. Send your fighters in the arena, position them strategically, create synergies and give the crowd a brutal show! Unlock your ultimate attacks, influence the course of the game and dominate The Hexadome!

games.name: Roguecraft DX
games.summary: The modern Amiga hit, winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, comes to Evercade in an all-new expanded, enhanced form!

games.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition
games.summary: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition includes the Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV base game, the downloadable content “Diplomacy and Strategy Expansion Pack Bundle,” Season Pass, Season Pass 2, and new content added in the Complete Edition.

games.name: Takeover 2
games.summary: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

games.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
games.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

games.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
games.summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero is the fourth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the Liberl arc and the beginning to the Crossbell arc. The game follows Lloyd Bannings and his colleagues Elie MacDowell, Randy Orlando, and Tio Plato. The four form the Special Support Section, a newly formed department of the Crossbell police in a city-state located between two great powers fighting for control over it.

games.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
games.summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure is the fifth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero and the ending to the Crossbell arc. The game follows the Special Support Section with more members and more cases to solve.

games.name: The Lightkeepers
games.summary: Grab your weapons and face an unequal battle against the nightmares of the deep! The Lightkeepers is a cooperative action game where you’ll fight for your life until every dawn!

games.name: Tsukikomori
games.summary: Tsukikomori is an Adventure game, developed by Pandora Box and published by Banpresto, which was released in Japan in 1996.

games.name: Wardogs
games.summary:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.summary: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Grandpa's Bee Haven
games.summary: Grandpa's Bee Haven is a desktop-idler and a beekeeping sim that sits at the bottom of your screen letting you to do other things while managing your bee haven.

games.name: Your Story: Games with Death
games.summary: A medieval text quest in the "Choose Your Own Adventure" genre, where each choice could be your last. Create your story with more than 2,000 events, 200 of which will prove fatal. In a world where death plays against you, can you outsmart it and write your own story?

games.name: Luduvo
games.summary: Luduvo is a user-generated content (UGC) sandbox gaming platform built on a proprietary engine. The platform allows players to create, share, and play community-designed games using a suite of built-in development tools and custom avatar configurations. Emphasizing digital safety and moderation, Luduvo features an in-game economy driven by virtual currency (Lunes).

games.name: Cloudscrapers
games.summary:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere.

Start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With each climb, you’ll improve, unlock upgrades, and reach new heights. As your tower rises, you’ll discover ancient relics and uncover secrets hidden deep within the clouds.

Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay without unnecessary complexity, the game blends replayable puzzle-strategy, meaningful progression, and a hand-drawn world you can get lost in.

games.name: Depth of Mind
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy game, you must assemble the strongest team of mental operatives to overcome mental illnesses inside a person.

games.name: Galactic Bounty
games.summary: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

games.name: GameZone: Game Store Simulator
games.summary:
GameZone is a first-person store management simulation game playable solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

Players operate a game shop by ordering stock, arranging products, setting prices, scanning purchases, serving customers, and fulfilling online orders. Revenue and reputation can be used to expand the business and unlock new products and abilities.

The store, furniture and player characters can be customised, while physics-driven object handling is used for everyday shop tasks.

games.name: Neat
games.summary: Neat is a game about helping people organize their lives by organizing their spaces.

games.name: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
games.summary: A dark fantasy JRPG. The imperial princess Chrysoberyl must fight the Bloody Emperor who has usurped the throne. However, her army is small and her allies are conniving. It is a bloody war where she will have to choose between peace and lives...

games.name: Rig Riot
games.summary: A fast-paced third-person mech-action roguelike

games.name: Rover’s Radventure: The New Millennium
games.summary: After a regular day at work transforms into a bizarre trip that turns his life upside down, a washed-up park ranger named Rover needs to step up and go on a journey that will take him far beyond his wildest fantasies and lead him to confronting uncomfortable truths about himself and his past.

games.name: Sigilfarer
games.summary: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!

games.name: Cloudbreaker
games.summary: Cloudbreaker is a roguelite, inventory management, bullet heaven. Explore a sky-world, finding relics and defeating hordes of enemies. Unlock and upgrade airships, each with its own unique layout, abilities, and strategies, to grow your power over time.

games.name: Crescent Break
games.summary: Blast robots, use their pieces to start chain reactions, and navigate your way through destructible levels in this platformer ROGUELIKE. Crescent Break fuses together NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. Augment your cyborg suit for ridiculous synergies, and try over and over to survive!

games.name: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed
games.summary:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

games.name: Dimraeth
games.summary: A 1-8 player fantasy RPG set in a handcrafted pixel world. Build your hero across 8 races and 6 classes. Explore ancient lands, master elemental combat, forge relationships, and shape a stronghold to call home. Fight for the fate of Dimraeth—together or alone.

games.name: Fright Train
games.summary: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Guinea Pig Gunner
games.summary: Guinea Pig Gunner is a run-and-gun platformer with boomer shooter DNA. It fuses skill-based action platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

games.name: Heroes Suck
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against an onslaught of heroes in this physics-enabled tower defense. Build your dungeon tile by tile, placing deadly traps to protect your loot. Upgrade your defenses and powers as you amass wealth and unleash havoc on these cheese wheel-stealing 'heroes'.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine
games.summary: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology. It is planned as the first installment in a trilogy of games focused on the X-Men.

games.name: Mixed Spirits
games.summary: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

games.name: Nuktedan: The Forgotten Emotions
games.summary: Rediscover the 7 emotions lost by a bird with Alzheimer's. Every memory is a color, every color is a power.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
games.summary: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: BloomKeeper
games.summary: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.

games.name: Brazilian Drug Dealer Before 4: Demons From the Portal to Hell I Opened Are Still in the Favela and Now I Have to Save Mamadas From Ronaldo
games.summary: The standalone sequel of the Brazilian boomer shooter game made using the id tech 2 engine! Shoot, jump, double jump and dash! Embark on a journey throughout the state of Rio De Janeiro, São Paulo, Salvador, hell and even heaven! Save Brazil!

games.name: Duo Quest
games.summary: Dive into a fantasy world where your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: Good Heavens!
games.summary: Good Heavens! Is an open-world crafting and building RPG. Embark on a solo adventure or team up with up friends, picking your tool of choice – sword, wand, or carpenter's hammer. Navigate the quirky races and cultures of the promised lands and restore them to their, ahem, intended glory.

games.name: Harvest Scream
games.summary: A co-op farming horror game about raiding unstable dimensions for seeds to grow and harvest for a hungry monster's daily quota.

games.name: Monowave
games.summary: Monowave is a whimsical puzzle-adventure platformer about the transformative power of emotions. Explore beautiful landscapes and empathize with its quirky denizens to restore harmony in an emotionally turbulent universe.

games.name: Oops! You're the Hero!
games.summary: Oops! You’re the Hero! is a fantasy adventure about a Thief who has stolen an artifact that deems him the ‘Hero’. Choose to fight or avoid the bosses who have sworn to defeat you, explore the world of Othaya, and return the artifact before more shenanigans befell you because…Oops! You’re the Hero!

games.name: Orebits
games.summary: Smash through alien rock with oversized mining gear, collect rare ores and uncover strange secrets. Orebits is a gritty sci-fi idle game full of mystery and metal.

games.name: Paratopic: Overdub
games.summary: Paratopic: Overdub revives the award-winning 2018 liminal horror classic: a twisting 3-in-1 remaster, remix, and sequel to the original.

games.name: Ride Up Together
games.summary: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is an online co-op motorcycle climbing game for 1–8 players. As you try to reach the summit, kick your friends to knock them off, overcome crazy physics-based obstacles, and don’t let even the smallest mistake send you back to the bottom!

games.name: Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

games.name: Two Point Hospital
games.summary:
Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.
Build and customise your hospital - it is yours after all - with specialist diagnosis and treatment facilities, as well as the very latest in ornamental technology!

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Akiba Lost
games.summary: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “Akiba’s Spirited Away”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

games.name: Another Eden Begins
games.summary: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

games.name: Endless Legend 2
games.summary: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

games.name: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
games.summary:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a turn-based strategy RPG centered around the Heroic Games, a tournament where warriors with different motivations compete for a chance to have their greatest wish granted by the Divine Sovereign. The game builds on the tactical foundation of previous Fire Emblem titles, featuring turn-based combat with combat arts, gambits, and crests. A new mechanic called Blaze Arts lets units spend health to perform powerful special abilities on the battlefield.
The game appears to be set in the same world as Fire Emblem: Three Houses, though in a different era, and follows characters like Cai, who enters the tournament to save his father's life.

games.name: Flamecraft
games.summary: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Day for Night
games.summary: These monsters aren’t just in the movies! Will you hunt the vampires, werewolves and others stalking Hollywood, or will you become a monster instead? An interactive, text-based game set in the World of Darkness shared story universe.

games.name: Maestro
games.summary: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication.

games.name: Patlabor the Case Files
games.summary: Relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this 3D console action game. Experience dual perspectives: Main Missions as the SV2, and Another Side Missions as their rivals. Hone your pilot skills in Simulator Mode, featuring shooting ranges and Labor duels.

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.summary:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren’t always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1. Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…
2. Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!
3. Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly, and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities, and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards, and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub, and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt, and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colorful, and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast, and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

games.name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
games.summary: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

games.name: The Bird of the North
games.summary: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

games.name: The Dead We Knew: Open World Survival
games.summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

games.name: The Housekeeper
games.summary: Work a 1900s night shift where routine chores meet an oppressive psychological dread. As a lone caretaker, navigate the heavy silence and unsettling shadows of a dark past. In this atmospheric horror, the terror lies in what remains unseen. Complete your tasks before the shift takes its toll.

games.name: Tiny Ramen Shop
games.summary: Run your own Tiny Ramen Shop! It's tiny, yes, but customers are already lining up to try your delicious ramen. Prepare food, stock your warehouse with fresh ingredients, upgrade and decorate your establishment. Hungry customers are waiting for their favorite ramen chef!

games.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
games.summary: A remake of the second installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter. The game follows Estelle as she sets out on a new adventure following the events of the previous game, where she will be joined by comrades both old and new.

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Two Sides of Hell
games.summary: Blast through procedurally generated alien hellscapes in this twin-stick roguelite platformer. Transform between human and demon to unleash devastating combat and survive the endless cycle of chaos.

games.name: Aibeya 3
games.summary:
"I want to become a man who can walk proudly by her side."

The protagonist, Kosuke Takahara, is in love with his childhood friend Suzume Azumino, who is one year older than him.

Because their families are close, the two of them have long maintained a relationship like "siblings." However, determined to put an end to that dynamic this summer, Kosuke has decided to confess his feelings during a joint family vacation.

Then comes the first day of the trip, and an unexpected problem strikes. Due to a booking error, they find themselves one room short.

Resigning himself to the situation, Kosuke offers the room to Suzume and prepares to share a room with his parents. However, Suzume speaks up.

"Is it not okay for Ko-kun and me to share a room?"

Kosuke is flustered by the proposal, thinking that even for childhood friends, a young man and woman sharing a room is... But in the end, Suzume wins him over, and they end up sharing a room.

"...I guess Suzu-nee really doesn't see me as a member of the opposite sex after all..."

Seeing how Suzume doesn't seem the least bit bothered by the arrangement, Kosuke quickly grows anxious about how things will go.

But he did not know. That Suzume, the one who suggested sharing the room, had also resolved to confess her love to Kosuke during this very trip...

games.name: EA Sports FC 27
games.summary: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA Sports FC 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

games.name: Havelyn
games.summary:
The game is a relaxed open-world building and exploration experience set in a large, quiet landscape. Players can explore alone or with up to four friends in co-op.

You choose where to settle and build a home anywhere in the world. Resources are gathered from the surrounding land, crops can be planted and harvested, and daily life is shaped by farming, crafting, and expanding your settlement. Nearby villages allow trading and interaction, and over time new residents can join, turning a small home into a growing community.

The world includes forests, meadows, villages, ruins, and hidden locations to discover. The focus is on exploration, settlement building, and gradual development at your own pace.

games.name: NASCAR 26
games.summary: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

games.name: Sandwich +1
games.summary: A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings. Your customers watch every move and react.

games.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
games.summary: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
games.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.summary:
Dressmaker is a cozy game inspired by real dressmaking.

Become a dressmaker, choose dress designs, cut out fabric and sew them all together to satisfy (or sabotage!) customers.

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: Thanks for the Soup
games.summary: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

games.name: BuGarden
games.summary: 《BuGarden》 is a cozy idle flower-growing game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Plant seeds, water and fertilize them at your own pace, harvest cute flowers and fruits, and deal with a few playful bugs—nothing messy, just a calm little garden keeping you company.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.summary: Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival MMO set on the desert planet Arrakis. Players create a custom character and must manage thirst, maintain stillsuits, and contend with environmental hazards like sandstorms, extreme heat, and roaming sandworms. The game involves scavenging resources, crafting equipment, building shelters, and competing with other players to harvest and transport spice. As players progress, they advance through phases from basic survival to leading a guild, eventually participating in faction warfare between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. The game features both PvE and PvP zones, with a Deep Desert area that reshapes weekly through Coriolis storms.

games.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
games.summary:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat from the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

games.name: Little Ghost
games.summary: Chill metroidvania maximizes non-linear exploration & puzzle-platforming. Frequent checkpoints, no currency, no combat. Gain friends & abilities. Collectables-as-media; tarot cards, weird podcasts, and songs from over 20 bands; all found within a surreal papercraft world.

games.name: Rivage
games.summary: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: True Vikings
games.summary: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

games.name: WildRoot
games.summary: A cozy colony sim where survival is gentle—but life is alive. Build, farm, cook, craft and grow your settlement as colonists form relationships, help each other, and shape small, meaningful stories together.

games.name: Gobble
games.summary: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

games.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

games.name: Union Max
games.summary:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next Light of the Kosmos!
Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness.
Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

games.name: Wind Runners
games.summary: For centuries, the Realm uses fear and its military superiority to keep the Zarah Igna System under control, but a group of rebellious Ishma arises to fight its tyranny. With their superior aerial combat skills, the Wind Runners will bring freedom to all who live under the shadow of oppression!

games.name: Card Conquest
games.summary: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.summary: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: Doggy Don't Care
games.summary: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

games.name: Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition
games.summary: The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music, the ability to switch between 2D and 3D graphic modes, a Japanese voice-acting option, and much more.

games.name: Dragon Shelter
games.summary: Dragon Shelter is a farm sim set in a fantasy world. Take on the role of a hero who will revive the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Take care of wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and restore destroyed biomes!

games.name: Farming Camp
games.summary: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

games.name: Fatal Train
games.summary: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

games.name: Garfield: Escape from Monday
games.summary: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

games.name: Ghostly Whiskers
games.summary:
