Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary: Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

games.name: Hell is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Kalanoro
games.summary: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

games.name: Misha
games.summary: It’s almost Christmas. Spend a quiet evening with Misha, where small choices can lead to unexpected consequences.

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
games.summary: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

games.name: Reel Talk
games.summary: Cast your line, catch some fish, and make real connections. REEL TALK is a cozy multiplayer fishing game where you hang out, customize your character with pride, and chat with friends old and new. No pressure, no competition-just good vibes by the water.

games.name: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance
games.summary: Slay the enemies in the silence of the moment. Run through the world of Shinobi full of monsters and ninja actions. Grab Oborozuki, the legendary sword, and slay evil once more. Your clan and the world are counting on you.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Tentacle Tango
games.summary: Tentacle Tango is a quirky co-op puzzle-platformer where you and a partner must work together, tethered by a flexible tentacle. Don’t let the cute visuals fool you—this game is as challenging as it is charming. Every jump, swing, and tentacle bend requires precise coordination as you navigate puzzles, obstacles, and enemies. Whether playing solo or in local co-op, teamwork is your only path to victory, because after all, it takes two to tango!

games.name: Cielle Is Not Happy
games.summary: Cielle Is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG that redefines the adventure genre through a deep, haunting narrative and unconventional combat mechanics, delivering a masterfully immersive experience.

games.name: Decklings
games.summary: Tame magical creatures called decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this survival deck-building card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft to build your base as you shape your path to become the deckling champion.

games.name: Online: 404
games.summary: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

games.name: Wavecrashers
games.summary: Wavecrashers is a 3-player co-op strategy game where heroes unite to fend off relentless waves of enemies. Master unique heroes and dive into a deeply replayable experience built for teamwork.

games.name: Tour: Chess Puzzles
games.summary: Elegant, varied and challenging chess-themed puzzles. No prior knowledge of chess is needed.

games.name: Unshine Arcade
games.summary: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Car Factory Tycoon
games.summary: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

games.name: Gretel's Honesty
games.summary: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

games.name: Medic Mayhem
games.summary: Toy soldiers fight on chaotic battlefields and you're the medic! Four player local coop with friends and bots. Win the war by saving lives!

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.summary: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.

games.name: Nivalis Nights
games.summary: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in Nivalis, the city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

games.name: Unwell
games.summary: You regain consciousness. Beside you lies a broken and rusted ladder, and in front of you stretches a dark, damp-smelling corridor. In the distance, you hear the sound of falling water. You have no idea where you are. All you know is that you must go deeper.

games.name: .45 Parabellum Bloodhound
games.summary: You play as Reila Mikazuchi; a washed out mercenary whose glory days are long gone. In a last attempt at grabbing life by the horns, she decides to go back to the life, only to realize the real enemy isn’t in front of her gun.

games.name: 100 Caliber Dash
games.summary: A high-speed run-and-gun shooter with roguelite deckbuilding upgrades.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

games.name: A Dungeon Is You
games.summary: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

games.name: A Forest Tale: Porasy
games.summary:
Embark on a journey through a new mythological realm as Porasy, an Indigenous warrior. Explore uncharted landscapes, unleash the power of Muiraquitãs, unravel your story, and vanquish the Seven Legendary Beasts to carve your own legend. Are you ready to dive into this epic adventure?

Porasy is an indie platformer that combines the thrill of classic 2D action with the rich, untold stories of the Tupi-Guarani mythology. Inspired by childhood favorites like Sonic and MegaMan, Porasy brings a fresh challenge to the platforming genre, immersing players in a dangerous, atmospheric world of Brazilian folklore.

games.name: A Game About Creating The Universe
games.summary: An idler game where you get to build up the universe from scratch. You are a part of an advanced space civilization that builds universes.

games.name: AGX GP
games.summary: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
games.summary: Aegis Force is a single player, story-driven, strategy RPG (SRPG) that has an engaging grid-based tactical combat system. It is designed in a breathtaking 2.5d pixel art style. Players can recruit for and customize their party, using gameplay that includes full world and town exploration.

games.name: Airport Control 27
games.summary: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

games.name: Alpha Spectrum
games.summary: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

games.name: Another's Memories
games.summary: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

games.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
games.summary: You play as the queen of ants, managing an anthill. Ants cannot be controlled directly, but you can create the necessary types of ants; improve them; organize raids, build a dungeon! The goal of each level is to destroy all enemy bases.

games.name: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
games.summary: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

games.name: Antropeo
games.summary: Antropeo is a geography trivia game focused on exploring, training, and competing through world-based challenges. Players can test their knowledge of countries, flags, shapes, places, and geography facts across solo modes, multiplayer duels, and marathon-style challenges. The game combines quiz gameplay, world exploration, profile progression, room-code multiplayer, and a space-themed visual style.

games.name: Appa
games.summary: Appa is a narrative driven simultaneous card game about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. You play as Varun witnessing surreal nightmares and manifestations of his deceased father and playing a card game with him.

games.name: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
games.summary: Build spell-powered factories, reclaim ancient territories filled with magical secrets, and discover game-changing technology hidden across procedurally generated worlds. Master both engineering and magic in this cozy fusion of factory automation and RPG progression.

games.name: Arcany
games.summary: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

games.name: Armada Pet Wars
games.summary: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

games.name: Art Studio Simulator
games.summary: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

games.name: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
games.summary: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

games.name: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos
games.summary: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

games.name: Astra Bestiary
games.summary: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: Backrooms Dream With Tung Tung Tung Sahur
games.summary: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

games.name: Bait Soul
games.summary: Bait Soul is a top-down Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. It blends dungeon exploration with Survivors-style auto-attacks. Accessible yet deep, it retains the thrill of looting, with unique, game-changing mechanics hidden everywhere.

games.name: Barefort
games.summary: "The fewer defenses you have, the more you become yourself." On the board, the score spreads over time, and corruption erodes. Stack units to create chain effects and turn the tide with minimal placement. Placing too many units will destroy you, while placing too few will prevent you from defending.

games.name: Beatcore Zero
games.summary: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.summary: Below the Stone is a pixel-art roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Beware of the Cartographer!
games.summary:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

games.name: Beyond The Cupola: ISS Simulator
games.summary: You are the ISS crew, where the station's fate depends on everyone. Oxygen leaks, system failures, meteorite threats — repair with your own hands and make real-time decisions. Complete missions, perform spacewalks. Experience life in orbit: in space, nothing goes according to plan.

games.name: Blackout
games.summary: Normal. Or Paranormal. A job sorting through ghost photos. Five days to finish. But it won't end there. Mysterious visitors. A fear that bleeds into reality. And—— Can you escape this curse?

games.name: Blackwood
games.summary: By day, you run a DVD store in 2012 New York. By night, you’re a ruthless assassin. BLACKWOOD is a cinematic third-person shooter with grounded melee combat, brutal takedowns, responsive gunplay, and a double life to manage.

games.name: Blindfold: Hide and Seek
games.summary:
Blindfold: Hide and Seek is an asymmetric online hide-and-seek game where one blindfolded seeker hunts several fugitives. Instead of relying on vision, the seeker tracks players through footsteps, echoes, and other environmental sounds, turning every tiny noise into a clue.
Fugitives can move around freely, but every movement and decision carries risk—sprint to escape faster, stay quiet to reduce your chances of being found, or use the environment to deceive the seeker. What starts as simple hide-and-seek becomes a tense psychological battle of sound, timing, and mind games.

games.name: BloodJack
games.summary: BloodJack, a 2-4 player PvP blackjack battler where every player hides card, manipulates opponents, uses rule-breaking items, and bets the blood keeping them alive as the stakes rise.

games.name: Blue Fire
games.summary: Embark on an extraordinary journey through the desolated kingdom of Penumbra and discover the hidden secrets of this long-forgotten land. Explore mystical temples, encounter survivors and take on strange quests to collect valuable items. Along your adventure, slash your way through daunting adversaries, roam across mysterious and abandoned regions, leap through deadly traps and ultimately master the art of movement.

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary:
Explore Bluey’s world like never before in Bluey's Happy Snaps!

Join Bluey and her family in a new photo-powered adventure game. Discover familiar locations, play with loads of toys, and use Bluey's camera to capture and keep all your favorite moments.

games.name: Bomb the Hill
games.summary: BOMB THE HILL is a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding experience inspired by the outlaw spirit of 70s freeride culture. Race through dangerous mountain roads, slide through traffic at insane speeds, discover hidden shortcuts, and survive brutal crashes

games.name: Broadside Bets
games.summary: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

games.name: Broom Racer
games.summary: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Evade enemies, pickup items to gain an advantage and fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost. Don't fall of your broom!

games.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
games.summary:
Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.

Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told—learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Burn With Me
games.summary: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.name: Bus Simulator: World Tour
games.summary: Bus Simulator: World Tour delivers the ultimate bus‑driving experience with realistic mechanics, detailed environments, and a massive fleet of vehicles. Travel the world behind the wheel of 30 unique buses across 14 real‑life inspired locations and complete 140 routes packed with variety and challenge. Customize your ride, explore freely, and enjoy a true next‑generation Bus Simulator built for immersion.

games.name: Card City Nights Forever
games.summary: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

games.name: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
games.summary: Carol and the Bells is a cozy, turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game played on a grid. Build a deck to shape what appears on the board, manage risk, and decide when to ring the bell and move on.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: Catnip Cosmos
games.summary:
A short incremental shooter.
Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

games.name: Celestay Craft&Slowlife
games.summary: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

games.name: Charming Hill
games.summary: Charming Hill is a small experimental game where creating beautiful paintings feels easy and natural. No artistic skills are needed; it’s a space to relax, paint, and discover a heartwarming story, or better yet, paint your own.

games.name: Chef's Dogma
games.summary: Chef’s Dogma is a roguelite turn-based battler where you journey through the 7-layers of bean dip hell. Upgrade your team through stats, items, or ‘entree’s creating even stronger foods. Experience a multitude of play-styles, Enemies, and locations to help the chef ascend into purgatory…

games.name: Chinese Strange Stories
games.summary: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

games.name: Chop Chop Together
games.summary: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op party game where housemates take on ridiculous jobs, earn cash, and put their friendships to the test during the wildest workdays imaginable. Work together under pressure, face unpredictable hazards, and survive fast-paced chaos where teamwork is the only way out.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Citadel
games.summary: Awake from your slumber and venture out to the mighty Citadel.

games.name: City Party
games.summary: City Party is an 8-player simultaneous turn-based party game. All players act at once—no waiting! Roll dice on beautifully crafted global city maps, use skills, control special tiles, play combo cards, challenge opponents, and collect legendary treasures. Win this urban adventure your way!

games.name: Clawless Coin
games.summary: Ever won something from a claw machine? Neither has this one. Clawless Coin is a cozy incremental arcade idler where you run a neon-lit claw machine arcade, chase six tiers of trophy plushes, and prestige into trillions of tokens. Grab big. Grip harder. Grow your empire.

games.name: Click & Mine
games.summary: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

games.name: Codebreakers VR
games.summary: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

games.name: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
games.summary: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

games.name: Collapsed Horizon
games.summary: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

games.name: Colorfall
games.summary: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

games.name: Company is Watching
games.summary:
Dear new employee, we are thrilled to welcome you to our production line. Here, your mission is simple, repetitive, and essential: maintain our quotas. Let yourself be lulled by the routine. Obey the instructions. Screw, clean, and destroy what you are told to destroy.

Optimization is our priority.

games.name: Computer Manufacturer
games.summary: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

games.name: Countryballs: The Heist
games.summary: Countryballs: The Heist is PWA's comedic stealth adventure where you become a master thief for eccentric clients. Customise your Countryball's disguise to explore maze-like countries. Plan, sabotage, hide and trick to outwit guards and traps - or create your own thrilling heists for the community.

games.name: Craving Wisps
games.summary: Slide in the walls, possess your enemies, and discover a mysterious world threatened by wicked spirits! This short adventure, full of action and humour, will please platformer fans and players looking for an original experience!

games.name: Creep
games.summary: Experimental dark platform game that takes place inside a struggled man's inner world represented as the worm world. You control the worm form of this man as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there. You also visit past memories/analogies and gain new abilities.

games.name: Creovia
games.summary: Creovia is a 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build your own worlds, craft powerful gear, trade with other players, and carve out your place in a persistent, player-driven universe.

games.name: Crewed
games.summary: Crewed is a 2–6 player cooperative spaceship management game. Players take on the role of corporate workers operating a fragile, poorly maintained spaceship for a megacorporation. The objective is to keep critical ship systems running, repair dynamic disasters, and complete procedurally generated missions while coordinating with the crew.

games.name: Crown of the Nile: Cleopatra's Choice
games.summary: Become Cleopatra VII in a historical romance visual novel of power, betrayal, and forbidden desire. Reclaim your throne, navigate Rome’s ambitions, and rewrite the fate of Ancient Egypt through your choices

games.name: Crystalyn
games.summary: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

games.name: Cute & Dead
games.summary: You might look like a typical nerd, but even a zombie apocalypse won't stop you from asking the girl of your dreams out on a date. All you need to do is find and rescue her from hordes of the living dead.

games.name: Czar Ry
games.summary: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

games.name: Dark Bros
games.summary: A chaotic online multiplayer arena brawler focused on physics-driven combat, bizarre abilities, and fast matches with friends.

games.name: Dark Stream
games.summary:
A desperate livestream. A house that shouldn’t be entered. A Twitch chat that won’t stay quiet. Survive the subathon as a disgraced creator, as the haunting awakens and your audience decides your fate.

In Dark Stream, you play a fearless content creator chasing clout by livestreaming from a house rumored to be haunted for decades. But this isn’t just exploration, you’re stepping directly into active paranormal events. Armed with your laptop, a flickering flashlight, and a live chat feed, you’ll push deeper into the house, uncover its violent past, and survive the encounters that react to you.

games.name: Dear Poe
games.summary:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

games.name: Dearbnb
games.summary:
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where you build a real estate empire one room at a time.

Start your journey by renting a small apartment in a modest neighborhood. Carefully decorate rooms, place furniture freely, set prices, and welcome tenants and customers. As you gain experience and reputation, unlock new zones — from poor districts to luxury neighborhoods and expand into residences, shops, and massive commercial properties.

Every room matters.
Every decision shapes your path to becoming a true property tycoon.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Demersus
games.summary:
Demersus is a first-person walking sim and psychological thriller experience that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction and how that influences the people around you, through environmental storytelling and immersive atmosphere. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape.

Created for the ZTGK game dev contest by a two-person indie team.

games.name: Demon Spore
games.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

games.name: Demra: Rifts of War
games.summary: Use powerful light magic to fight back the invading demon hordes in this lite-RPG/ RTS mix. Build a base, gather resources, research and command your army.

games.name: Deorum
games.summary: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

games.name: Deserter
games.summary: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

games.name: Desolation Arcanist
games.summary: Craft your own magic in this action roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

games.name: DieMansion
games.summary: Escape a dark, randomly generated mansion where creatures stalk you in the shadows. Outsmart them by manipulating the environment, restoring the power, and scavenging supplies to survive.

games.name: Diffusion
games.summary: Build defenses to protect your mining sites from the hostile native alien species. Explore the planet and discover the true reasons you've been sent here for. A true old school pixel-art experience.

games.name: Dimenshot
games.summary: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

games.name: Dinerz
games.summary:
Dinerz is a diner simulation game, where you manage you own diner.
Cook meals, server customers, clean tables, wash dishes and hire staff, you can play alone or with your friends.

games.name: Dissolution of My Self
games.summary: A prince who has lost his kingdom and everything else. His uncle and aide-de-camp, unable to leave him. In a cramped rented room abroad, click on objects and piece together a codependent relationship filled with brutality and endurance. Watch helplessness turn into violence, tenderness into torture.

games.name: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
games.summary: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!

games.name: Dodgebrawl
games.summary: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. It's a multiplayer PvP dodgeball-themed FPS, full of maps, game modes, equipment, and chaos.

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.name: Draco and the Seven Scales
games.summary: Discover the mysteries of the great ocean in Draco and The Seven Scales! Explore dungeons, collect items, and fight scallywags on land and on the seven seas.

games.name: Dravenmoor
games.summary: A fantasy sidescroller to search your missing friend in a mysterious town. Inspired by Alice in Wonderland and various punk artworks.

games.name: Dread Admiral
games.summary: A turn-based naval roguelite where every ship you lose is gone forever. The Black Fleet hunts you. Your Flagship must survive.

games.name: Dreadnought Tartarus
games.summary: Dreadnought Tartarus is a semi-automated strategic simulation game centered around a single, colossal battleship. Take control of the massive warship Tartarus and destroy everything in your path as the battlefield continuously advances！

games.name: Dream Delirio's
games.summary: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

games.name: Drillbound
games.summary: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

games.name: Driving Test Simulator
games.summary: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios. Offers various scenarios and environments.

games.name: Duelgrounds
games.summary: Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where every round brings a new weapon and every decision matters. Master the entire arsenal, manage limited resources, and outplay your opponents through skill, strategy, and adaptation.

games.name: DungeonBox
games.summary: A new Dungeons & Dragons Party Game! Let our Dungeon Master take you and up to 8 players on an adventure, where you control the next move by answering and voting from your phones

games.name: Dwarven Forge
games.summary: Master the depths in Dwarven Forge. Use your fireball-flinging lantern to clear paths and mine rare ores. Incrementally upgrade your digging power, node yields, and forging skills to craft and sell legendary weapons. Descend, optimize, and unlock the secrets of the ancient mountain.

games.name: EVE Vanguard
games.summary: EVE Vanguard is an upcoming sci-fi sandbox FPS where every deployment onto a hostile planet is high stakes. You fight, scavenge, and adapt in brutal warzones - and every choice leaves its mark on a player-driven universe at war.

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Echoes of the Scourge
games.summary: Every year, a festival is held to celebrate the founding of Springure, a small and quaint town. Odette, a girl grieving a dear friend, suddenly finds herself in an empty, distorted version of her hometown.

games.name: Economic Miracle
games.summary: Build your own state in the most detailed economic simulator! Playing for the government of any country in the world, you will have to conduct domestic and foreign policy, pass laws, carry out economic reforms and fight. Try a real simulator of modern times!

games.name: Elation for the Wonder Box 6000
games.summary: Elation For The Wonder Box 6000 is a first-person, claymation adventure game about going into the city to try and find a game from your youth that no one else remembers.

games.name: Electric Sheep
games.summary: Dredge the memories of an old Butler Robot to piece the past together and solve a Murder at a family home.

games.name: EmbeRogue
games.summary: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

games.name: Endless Silent Night
games.summary: An all-ages port of 12 no Tsuki no Eve.

games.name: Endless Tactics
games.summary: Endless Tactics is a turn-based roguelite game. Play as the commander of a high-risk planetary mining operation, defend your base from alien creatures while trying not to get overrun. Use resources to upgrade your starship, unlock new technologies, powerups, and deadly new worlds to harvest.

games.name: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
games.summary: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: Exofactory
games.summary: Awaken as a forgotten AI on an alien world, your every choice reshapes your technology, environment, and identity. Automate deeply transformative factories in a chill open world, where the story evolves uniquely around you.

games.name: Exorcist Hotline
games.summary: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

games.name: Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

games.name: Eye of Syn
games.summary: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

games.name: Fairy Springs
games.summary: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

games.name: Fallosophy
games.summary: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

games.name: Fallout 76
games.summary: Fallout 76 is an online action role-playing game and the first multiplayer entry in the Fallout series. Set in 2102 in Appalachia, West Virginia, players control a resident of Vault 76 who ventures into the open world 25 years after a nuclear war. The game features exploration, questing, base building, and combat against mutated creatures and hostile factions. It can be played solo or cooperatively, with players sharing servers and engaging in trade or PvP combat.

games.name: Fame or Folly
games.summary: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite

games.name: Farming With Lasers
games.summary: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

games.name: Five More Minutes
games.summary: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

games.name: FleetLord
games.summary: A space RTS about decisions, not menus. Conquer planets, link them to fuel your war machine, and level up your empire with randomized perk cards. Crush all opposition.

games.name: Flipper on Recoil
games.summary: Flipper on Recoil is a fast-paced 3D platformer where a fish with legs and a shotgun takes on gravity. Use recoil, power-ups, and absurd tricks to blast through handcrafted levels and chase your best times.

games.name: Fluff Up
games.summary: Fluff Up is a charming yet challenging game where you control a chubby little bird flapping through a fantastical sea of clouds. Master your speed, manage your stamina, and ride the clouds to reach the highest skies.

games.name: Folders on the Run
games.summary: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

games.name: Football Club Builder
games.summary: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

games.name: Footsy
games.summary: Footsy is a chaotic multiplayer soccer party game set inside grandma's house! Smash furniture, shatter bottles, and tumble TVs as you compete in wild, goal-scoring action. Customize your characters, challenge your friends, and embrace the crazy destruction in every room!

games.name: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
games.summary: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

games.name: Forsworn
games.summary: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this rogue lite, turn-based tactics adventure where no hero fights alone. Build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles and defy fate in a world controlled by the gods.

games.name: Fortunato
games.summary: Draw a pair of aces, use them as poker hands or to eliminate your opponents? A poker roguelike battle card game. Build a deck of jokers, defeat bosses, modify cards, and conquer challenges across the ever-changing islands. At the table of four, win by chips or remaining health, your call...

games.name: Freelance Dead
games.summary: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

games.name: Frog It Up
games.summary: Frog It Up is an incremental clicker game where you lure frogs to a pond and help them build their own cozy little city. As the pond grows, you’ll decide which upgrades to unlock, shaping how the city expands over time and steering progress in the direction you prefer.

games.name: FrogSpin
games.summary: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action?

games.name: Frontier Wars: Online
games.summary: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

games.name: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
games.summary: Furyball is a fast paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

games.name: Future? No Thanks!
games.summary: Future? No Thanks! is a narrative-driven, open-world adventure set in an ecosocialist utopia. You're old, bitter, and scheduled for euthanasia. Enjoy your last day in a future that works for everyone but you.

games.name: GTL Schedule
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

games.name: Galaxy Critter Co.
games.summary: Galaxy Critter Co. is a cute chaotic roguelike where tower defense meets top-down shooting: build by day, fight by night, and craft broken synergies to survive the Swarm.

games.name: Garden Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

games.name: Gladio Mori
games.summary: Gladio Mori is a cutting-edge physics-based multiplayer fighting game where you use razor-sharp weapons to cut down your enemies or die trying. Pick your blade, choose your armour and create a fighting style unique to you. Enter the arena to face your friends or hone your abilities against the AI.

games.name: Godreaper
games.summary: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

games.name: Good Catch!
games.summary: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Gridlords
games.summary: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

games.name: Growing My Manhole
games.summary: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

games.name: Guild of Three
games.summary: Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you command a party of three characters — each with their own deck. Combine different classes, pass relay cards between allies, and position your party across the front and back lines to create your own combat strategy.

games.name: Gun Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: Gun Shop: Tidy Up — a tidy-up simulator where you need to put more than 2,700 items back in their places. Pick up, arrange, upgrade and just relax while restoring order in a gun shop.

games.name: Gunny Ascend
games.summary: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure — Stack, Adapt, Escape! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

games.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
games.summary: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

games.name: Hang Out
games.summary: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

games.name: Harbingers of Destiny
games.summary: When Strata is unwittingly caught up in an international incident, she is forced to team up with border guard Leonel and escort a mysterious yet timid mage to the capital city. But as tensions rise between nations, they soon realize there’s more at play than they could have ever imagined.

games.name: Hats and Guns
games.summary: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

games.name: Hellcard II
games.summary: Hellcard II is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played solo or with a team of up to four players. The game takes place in the paper dungeons known from Hellcard and Book of Demons, expanding into new biomes and storylines.

games.name: Hemobloom
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

games.name: Heroes of Anirea
games.summary: Heroes of Anirea blends turn-based tactics with roguelite progression in a character-driven strategy experience. Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills, and evolve your approach as new challenges arise.

games.name: Hide and Fuse
games.summary: Turn into a lamp. Freeze. Pray. One player carries a live bomb and hunts the room — everyone else is furniture. Blend in, hold your nerve, and pass the bomb before it blows. A party game of disguise, panic, and betrayal for 2–10 players (or grab a few and let the chaos fill the rest)

games.name: Homepage
games.summary: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

games.name: Homo Sovieticus
games.summary: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

games.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
games.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

games.name: How to Fish
games.summary: You and your friends are out drinking and boating. You crash into a small island where you have to fish using everything from fishing rods to assault rifles. Sell your catch, earn money, buy better fishing gear, and defeat boss fishes to unlock new islands and finally make it back home.

games.name: Human Resources
games.summary: You work in Human Resources. In this dystopian document thriller, use your terminal to scrutinize records and expose human-like AI. Spot contradictions to detect the impostors. Efficiency is mandatory. Failure is unforgivable.

games.name: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
games.summary: A 2D platform game about the ancient stories of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, who live in the Brazilian Amazon. The entire game was produced in collaboration with the Huni Kuin communities of the Jordão river, in Acre.

games.name: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
games.summary: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

games.name: IPS 13: All Signals Lost
games.summary: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. Be prepared for the worse and ready to fight. Upgrade your VOD, hire new crew factions, to be the ultimate War Machine.

games.name: Idle Bookstore
games.summary: A cozy idle bookstore you grow from a tiny shop into a thriving business — solo or with friends. Co-work together, write books as a group, and sell each other’s books for profit.

games.name: Illegal Plantation
games.summary: It’s time to leave it all behind and do a dance with the law. Build your own illegal plantation, plant your weed, water them, maintain good air temperature and good lighting. Deliver your goods or hire local dealers for it. Get rid of the competition and build your own monopoly.

games.name: Industrix
games.summary: Step into the world of industrial production and become a master in factory-building! Create efficient production lines and manage your resources. As you progress through the game, you'll need to complete challenges for a certain company in order to rank up and unlock new technologies!

games.name: Industronaut
games.summary:
Industronaut is a first-person survival engineering game set on a hostile, radiation-heavy planet.

You were left behind after a failed evacuation. Alone on the surface, you must build a sealed habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine raw resources, and turn them into the systems that keep you alive.

Expand from a small survival shelter into an industrial base. Process resources through production chains, unlock new machines, manage power, storage, and logistics, and use drones to scan for ore deposits and move materials between machines and storage.

There is no combat and no rescue waiting for you. Survival depends on engineering, automation, and your ability to keep the base running.

games.name: Inner Rooms
games.summary: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

games.name: InterViolence
games.summary: Wander through a secret lair. Help a young supervillain move out of his lifelong home. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. The third entry in the Violence series.

games.name: Interred
games.summary: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

games.name: Island Restoration
games.summary: Bring procedurally generated islands back to life. Explore different biomes and damage scenarios. Relax as you clean, upgrade your tools, rescue wildlife, and watch each island return to its natural beauty. Customize your ship and decorate your own private island.

games.name: It's Fine
games.summary: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

games.name: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
games.summary: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

games.name: Keysaster
games.summary: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

games.name: King's Guard
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

games.name: Kwad
games.summary: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

games.name: Last Rites
games.summary: You're ten years old and live with your grandparents. Father Aldous has come to read your grandmother her last rites. Now he says the house must be cleansed of sin. Stay out of sight.

games.name: Lisia
games.summary: Drive your truck on deadly roads. Use the winch, build bridges, and spray-paint the body. Reach the summit alone or in co-op with friends. And remember the main rule: don't look down!

games.name: Living on Plain Pasta
games.summary: A conversation adventure where you spend the worst, best summer visiting your booze-loving senpai, making weird food, and sneaking out together at midnight.

games.name: Local Supermarket Tycoon
games.summary: Design the perfect neighbourhood supermarket! Research customer needs, carefully stock your shelves, and plan every aisle to maximize traffic and boost impulse sales

games.name: Local Zombies
games.summary: Death is just a career change. Shape unique characters in this turn-based life sim, then resurrect them as zombie companions. Transform their past talents into tactical advantages to take over the city.

games.name: Logbook: Beneath the Storm
games.summary: A narrative deduction game where you uncover a dark maritime mystery by piecing together clues and hidden connections. Step into the role of a detective, reconstruct past events, identify those involved, and reveal the truth behind a series of grim incidents at sea.

games.name: Look Up and Go
games.summary: Wishlist this fast paced, fps, score attack where every run is a risk. Use your points to bet on your own survival or make other players' runs harder. Get combos by stabbing, shooting, and doing tricks. Ascend the tower. Climb the leader board. Wishlist now.

games.name: Loot Goblins
games.summary: Crack open chests, chain buffs, upgrade and recruit the ultimate goblin crew. Send them deeper into dungeons. Get better loot. Repeat!

games.name: Lost in the Roots
games.summary: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Magic Shop Chaos
games.summary: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

games.name: Make The Dead Dead Again
games.summary: In this third-person action-adventure, use Lux’s gun skills and enhanced DNA abilities to clear out enemies as she searches for her missing mother. Along the way, level up and acquire loot to equip her - and her home base - with an insane variety of customisation options.

games.name: Marie Android
games.summary: Do you like Marie‑chan? You play as Marie Android, a small girl‑like robot who meets many friends. Using mysterious powers, she can become muscular, flatten into a paper‑thin form, or transform into a giant tank to fight enemies. Borrow your friends’ abilities and save Akacha Town.

games.name: Mayfly
games.summary: Mayfly is a story-rich, quiet horror set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. A short psychological horror experience focused on exploration, story and atmosphere. Search a detailed, highly explorable narrowboat setting that evolves as the mystery unfolds. Uncover clues and memories amidst unsettling shifts in the environment around you. Solve puzzles to guide Caroline on her journey to be reunited with her husband Robert.

games.name: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
games.summary: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

games.name: Medix
games.summary: How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

games.name: Meow Box City
games.summary: Meow Box City is a multiplayer, strategy-focused game where, ahead of the upcoming local elections, you build your own lobby against rival parties, thwart your opponents’ plans with devious schemes, and try to boost your popularity in the city by making the right moves at the right time. Collect cards, place your buildings, balance satisfaction–population–revenue… and secure the ballot boxes on election night. Let’s keep this between us: we’re winning...

games.name: Michael Test
games.summary: Michael Test is a point-and-click adventure game where you uncover hidden truths within classical paintings and follow faint traces of sound to deduce and choose the final ‘sin.’

games.name: Micro Titans Wrestling
games.summary: Micro Titans Wrestling is a nostalgia fuelled roguelike deck builder themed on the golden age of professional wrestling. Prepare to step into the ring with a roster of era defining characters and take it to the mat with a unique card battle system.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

games.name: Mimic Party
games.summary: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

games.name: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
games.summary: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

games.name: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
games.summary: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

games.name: Mithra
games.summary: A cryptic puzzle/adventure game that blurs the line between fiction and reality. A tale of cultish affairs that sweeps through the nighttime streets of London, weaves through the back alleys of Beijing and beyond. Come with us.

games.name: Mobius
games.summary: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

games.name: Moorestech
games.summary: Factory automation meets anime-style RPG. Harness gears and shafts to power machines and conveyors, building an automated factory. Produce items and research tech, evolving from windmills to fusion as you trace humanity’s tech evolution, then launch a rocket home to uncover the truth of your exile.

games.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
games.summary: "Murders on the Yangtze River" is a horizontal axis Chinese-style whodunnit detective game developed by OMEGames Studio. Players will find out the hidden truths of the final case through investigating and reasoning a pile of fantastic cases.

games.name: Myth of Valderit
games.summary:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

games.name: Nero
games.summary: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

games.name: Next Reign: Kingdom
games.summary: Medieval incremental kingdom builder combining city building, resource management, automation and auto-battler combat.

games.name: Nightwater
games.summary: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

games.name: No More Pesticide
games.summary: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs, building a farm, and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

games.name: Nomad Drive
games.summary: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

games.name: Nowhere
games.summary:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

games.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
games.summary: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

games.name: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
games.summary: An alluring oiran dances through the blood-soaked nights of Edo. Where beauty and violence collide — a dopamine-fueled survival action.

games.name: Okurek
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
games.summary: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

games.name: One Dumb Wizard
games.summary: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to get your money back.

games.name: OneStarHotel
games.summary: Run a chaotic one-star hotel with your friends. Cook meals, serve guests, manage the restaurant, and survive the night while hiding the hotel's darkest secret

games.name: Onigashima: Awakening
games.summary: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

games.name: Only Humans On Board
games.summary: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

games.name: Open Drive
games.summary: Explore freely, collect the orbs, or try to beat your high score by making and landing jumps off ramps, mounds, and mountain tops in our 3 vehicles, Roadster, Trickster and Speedste

games.name: Orbit to Riches
games.summary: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

games.name: Order 13 VR
games.summary: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

games.name: Otpisani: Nightingale
games.summary: A retro shooter game inspired by old TV show. You play as a part of resistance movement and fight German occupation in a set of explosive missions while experiencing exciting story.

games.name: Panzer Strike
games.summary: Authentic RTS gameplay straight out of the 2000s. Command your troops, develop strategies, and win World War II battles. Huge maps, thousands of units, long-range firepower, and no building mechanics!

games.name: Pao Pao
games.summary: Pao Pao is a wild mix of culinary diving and animal madness—where you become the ultimate restaurant boss and management guru! Gather ingredients, go fishing, and expand your spot solo or with friends. Every order turns into an epic adventure… Jump in and experience it for yourself!

games.name: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
games.summary: "Paradise Beyond the Nightmare" is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

games.name: Pelican Empyrean
games.summary: Food is love! In this fantastical roguelike card game share the magic of abundance by cooking delicious meals for all who come to Pelican's kitchen.

games.name: Penguin Festival
games.summary: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

games.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
games.summary: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

games.name: Permaban
games.summary: It's 2007. You're a forum mod with dial-up, a rulebook that contradicts itself, and a community spiraling into chaos. Ban trolls, cite rules, survive burnout. Papers Please meets early internet culture.

games.name: PhantomZone Labyrinthos
games.summary: ”The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.” You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you. She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android. The stage is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her.

games.name: Pibcremental
games.summary: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world. Gather resources, build wacky structures and play mini-games to push your production to its absolute limits!

games.name: Pigeon Guild
games.summary: Pigeon Guild is a non-combat, single-player action RPG where you play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in Cassandria's most prestigious airborne postal service. Navigate your flying cargo boat through a world of floating islands, where every delivery tells a story.

games.name: Play Faster
games.summary: Play Faster is a precision platformer built for fast movement, instant retries, and endlessly replayable runs. Master movement, optimize routes, and climb online leaderboards with built-in speedrunning tools.

games.name: Please, Spin
games.summary: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

games.name: Plobania 47/B
games.summary: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: Police Chief Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

games.name: Polydangerous
games.summary: Build and defend a mining operation on a distant planet in this tower defense bullet heaven shooter. Build and upgrade defenses, fight off waves of enemies from a rival corporation, and earn enough credits to buy your body back and escape this deep space hellhole.

games.name: Port of Jumanah
games.summary: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

games.name: Posthumors
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what happens to people after they die? We created “Posthumors,” an online project that allows you to experience death and communicate with the afterlife through words. Now then — take up your pen, and face death.

games.name: Potions of Veldenkeep
games.summary: Run your own alchemist shop in the fantasy City of Adventurers! Grow plants, brew potions, set prices, and serve curious villagers. Earn gold, build reputation, and expand your craft in this cozy first-person herbalist simulator.

games.name: ProTax 98
games.summary: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

games.name: Project Octavia
games.summary: A stylized third-person spy action game with infiltration, gunplay, Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative and dynamic sabotage gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!

games.name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
